mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS "CNT" FROM MSTCOMP WHERE COMPID = #{COMPID} AND COMPYN = 'Y'
SELECT DOCUTY AS "DOCUTY" FROM DOCTM WHERE DOCCAT = '000'

SELECT A.SHPOKY AS "SHPOKY" , A.DPTNKY AS "RPTNKY" , A.DNAME1 AS "RPTNNM" , C.LOTNUM AS "AWMSNO" , D.LOTA02 AS "LOTA02" , D.LOTA03 AS "LOTA03" , D.LOTA04 AS "PTNRKY" , D.LOTA05 AS "PTNRNM" FROM SHPDH A INNER JOIN SHPDI B ON A.COMPKY = B.COMPKY AND A.SHPOKY = B.SHPOKY INNER JOIN TASDI C ON B.COMPKY = C.COMPKY AND B.SHPOKY = C.SHPOKY AND B.SHPOIT = C.SHPOIT AND B.SKUKEY = C.SKUKEY INNER JOIN LOTAT D ON C.COMPKY = D.COMPKY AND A.WAREKY = D.WAREKY AND C.SKUKEY = D.SKUKEY AND C.LOTNUM = D.LOTNUM WHERE A.COMPKY = #{COMPID} AND A.SHPOKY = #{SHPOKY} AND B.SHPOIT = #{SHPOIT} AND A.STATDO IN('FSH','PSH') LIMIT 1
